newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Seven killed, 28 injured in Hong Kong blaze.
newsitem.headline: Seven killed, 28 injured in Hong Kong blaze.

text.p: Seven people were killed and 28 injured when a fire raged through a residential building on Hong Kong's Kowloon peninsula on Tuesday, the government said.
The dead included four women, two baby girls and one man, the government's information service said.
The government information service earlier reported 43 people were injured but later revised the number down to 28.

Residents squatted on window ledges and clung to drainpipes to escape the fire as it spread from a sixth-floor apartment in a 20-storey block in Kowloon's Mei Foo district. The cause of the blaze was not immediately known.
Hong Kong has seen some of its worst building fires on record in recent months.
In November, a building in Kowloon's Nathan Road tourist shopping street turned into an inferno, killing 39 people and injuring 81 in the territory's worst blaze in a building.
A fire in a karaoke bar in January killed 17 people in Kowloon's Tsimshatsui entertainment district.
